accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the scale of village and ward secretariats in Andhra Pradesh?
o: More than 15,000 secretariats offering more than 1,000 services
More than 20,000 secretariats offering more than 500 services
More than 10,000 secretariats offering more than 500 services
More than 5,000 secretariats offering more than 200 services
accepted.x: The village and ward secretariat system comprises more than 10,000 secretariats and offers more than 500 services.
accepted.tq: Match both quantitative dimensions rather than identifying only one correct figure.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding recent welfare and governance developments in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: The Disha Bill was withdrawn in September 2025.
The Disha Bill was enacted in August 2026.
The Disha Bill was transferred to local governments in August 2026.
The Disha Bill was withdrawn in August 2026.
accepted.x: The Disha Bill was withdrawn in August 2026.
accepted.tq: Use precise date-and-event matching and avoid reversing enactment with withdrawal.
